svg.title: OpenMeet SQLite schema v2 - physical ER diagram (crow's foot)

g.text: OpenMeet SQLite schema v2 - physical ER diagram (crow's foot)

g.id: cluster_Not meeting data (kept by delete_all_meeting_data and retention)
g.text: Not meeting data (kept by delete_all_meeting_data and retention)
* = NOT NULL; «PK» primary key; «FK» = meeting_id REFERENCES meetings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
«UK1» = UNIQUE (meeting_id, item_id, kind, model); "= x" = DEFAULT x
All 15 tables are STRICT (v2 adds integrity_flags, migration 0002). INTEGER timestamps = Unix ms (transcript start_time/end_time = ms from meeting start).
Enums are stored as snake_case TEXT; list columns (parts, segment_ids, followups, entities, summary lists) are JSON TEXT.
embeddings.vector is the only BLOB (little-endian f32 x dims). No raw audio and no screenshots are stored.
meeting_summaries.meeting_id is both PK and FK, so a meeting has at most one summary (0..1).
The only declared foreign keys are the 12 meeting_id ones drawn here (all ON DELETE CASCADE); other id columns are not enforced (see er-03).
integrity_flags: one row per checked candidate answer (interviewer mode, check turned on); a re-check
replaces the row (revision grows). signals and elevated are JSON; no audio, frames or gaze samples are stored.
Schema version is tracked with PRAGMA user_version (SCHEMA_VERSION = 2), not with a table.
